f3_program: observe(at("steve.earnings.required_total", "four_days"), 100, "dollar", source("make a total of $100 within four days"))
observe(at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), 2, "dollar_per_pound", source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))

rate_relation(at("steve.earnings.required_total", "four_days"), at("berry_picking_job.pay_rate", "current"), at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), source("The job paid $2 for every pound of lingonberries picked"))
produce("monday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), 8, source("On Monday he picked 8 pounds"))

produce("tuesday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), scale(event_field("monday_harvest", "quantity"), 3), source("Tuesday’s harvest was triple what he had picked the previous day"))
produce("thursday_harvest", "steve", at("steve.lingonberries.picked.weight", "current"), "steve.lingonberries.thursday_harvest.weight", source("pick on Thursday"))
query("value", event_field("thursday_harvest", "quantity"))
assumptions: Resting on Wednesday is represented by the absence of a Wednesday harvest event; no unstated numeric zero is introduced.

f3_program: collection("anna.garden.lettuce_plants", "lettuce_plant", "garden", source("grow some lettuce in the garden"))
observe(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), 12, "count", source("at least 12 large salads"))

remove("lettuce_loss", "insects_and_rabbits", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), fraction(at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "initial"), 1, 2), source("half of the lettuce will be lost to insects and rabbits"))
observe(at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), 3, "large_salad_per_plant", source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))

rate_relation(at("anna.large_salads.minimum_required.count", "current"), at("lettuce_plant.large_salad_yield", "current"), at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "current"), source("Each lettuce plant is estimated to provide 3 large salads"))
query("value", at("anna.garden.lettuce_plants.count", "initial"))
assumptions: The query asks for the minimum initial plant count that meets the stated at-least target after the anticipated loss.

f3_program: collection("ethan.candles", "candle", "ethan", source("Ethan makes beeswax candles"))
